app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: nginx-thrift is misconfigured: its Lua/Thrift code is attempting to connect to localhost:8080 for the compose endpoint but there is no service/proxy listening on that local port, causing connection refused failures.
rca_analyses_list.reasoning:
1) Pod spec shows a single nginx-thrift container (no sidecar) exposing port 8080 and mounting nginx.conf from ConfigMap — there is no local proxy process defined in the pod to accept thrift calls.
2) The nginx ConfigMap (nginx.conf) listens on port 8080 and includes wrk2 API locations (e.g., /wrk2-api/post/compose), indicating the server is configured to handle these paths but not to provide a separate local backend.
3) nginx logs contain repeated errors: "compose.lua: compost_post failure: connect() failed: Connection refused" and show the request target "POST http://localhost:8080/wrk2-api/post/compose" — demonstrating the Lua/Thrift client is trying to connect to localhost:8080 and failing. Together these show the client is pointed at localhost:8080 while no local backend is bound there, causing the observed failures.

insights: Pod 'nginx-thrift-7c48f57-4nn69' runs a single openresty/nginx container exposing containerPort 8080; there is no sidecar or separate local backend container in the pod.

ConfigMap 'nginx-thrift' provides nginx.conf which listens on port 8080 and defines multiple Lua content handlers (including /wrk2-api and /api/* locations) but does not provide a separate upstream backend service within the pod.

Pod logs contain repeated errors: 'connect() failed: Connection refused' and Thrift exceptions originating from compose.lua. Log lines show the Lua/Thrift client attempted to connect to 'http://localhost:8080/wrk2-api/post/compose'.

Correlation of pod spec, ConfigMap, and logs shows the Lua/Thrift code is configured (or hardcoded) to contact localhost:8080 as a backend, but no process is listening on that local socket inside the pod — this causes the connection refused failures.

Confirmed hypotheses: (a) logs show connection refused to localhost:8080 (confirmed); (b) nginx configuration and Lua handlers handle the API paths (confirmed); (c) root cause is a misconfiguration where the client points to localhost:8080 while no local backend exists (confirmed).
Impact: compose (post/compose) requests repeatedly fail with connection refused, causing that functionality to be unavailable.

Recommended remediation: update the Lua/Thrift client configuration to call the correct backend service (use the proper Kubernetes Service DNS:port), or deploy the expected local proxy/sidecar bound to localhost:8080 so the client has a listener to contact.

args.diagnosis: nginx-thrift is misconfigured to call the compose-post endpoint on localhost:8080, but compose-post is exposed as a ClusterIP service on port 9090 (compose-post-service -> 10.96.181.131:9090) and the compose-post pod listens on 9090. This mismatch causes connect() refused and Thrift transport errors.
args.reasoning: Evidence: (1) nginx-thrift logs show repeated errors: "connect() failed: Connection refused" and requests targeting "POST http://localhost:8080/wrk2-api/post/compose" indicating nginx/lua is attempting to reach localhost:8080. (2) The nginx-thrift pod mounts ConfigMap nginx-thrift (nginx.conf) which runs the lua client endpoints; logs indicate the lua client is using localhost. (3) The compose-post Service manifest shows clusterIP 10.96.181.131 and port name "9090" (port: 9090 -> targetPort: 9090). (4) The compose-post pod (compose-post-service-64f6c9b656-tq7l7) has container port 9090 and is Ready. Therefore the failure domain is configuration: nginx is pointing at localhost:8080 rather than the cluster service address/port (compose-post-service:9090).

message_history.content: Final diagnosis submitted successfully. Investigation complete.

final_report.root_cause: nginx-thrift was misconfigured to call the compose-post endpoint at http://localhost:8080 (hardcoded in its nginx/lua config) while the actual compose-post service and pod are exposed/listening on port 9090 (compose-post-service:9090). The lua/Thrift client in the nginx-thrift pod attempted connections to localhost:8080 where no process was listening, producing connect() refused and Thrift TTransportException errors and causing compose (post/compose) requests to fail. A separate, unrelated scheduling misconfiguration caused the user-service pod to remain Pending (nodeSelector/taint mismatch).
final_report.evidence_summary: 1) nginx-thrift pod logs: repeated errors 'connect() failed: Connection refused' and Thrift TTransportException, showing requests targeting 'POST http://localhost:8080/wrk2-api/post/compose'. 2) Pod spec for nginx-thrift runs a single openresty/nginx container (no sidecar) exposing containerPort 8080 and mounts ConfigMap 'nginx-thrift' containing nginx.conf with Lua handlers that call the compose endpoint. 3) compose-post Service manifest shows ClusterIP 10.96.181.131 port 9090 and compose-post pod 'compose-post-service-64f6c9b656-tq7l7' listens on container port 9090 and is Ready. 4) kubectl describe of user-service pod shows Status: Pending with Node-Selectors: kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node and an untolerated taint node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane present on one node — explaining scheduling failure.
final_report.investigation_summary: Priority-1 investigation inspected nginx-thrift pod spec, mounted ConfigMap (nginx.conf), and pod logs; found the Lua/Thrift client attempting to reach localhost:8080 and no local listener in the pod. Priority-2 investigation validated the compose-post service/pod: compose-post is exposed on port 9090 (ClusterIP 10.96.181.131:9090) and its pod listens on 9090 and is Ready. Correlation of logs, pod config, and Service manifests demonstrates a configuration mismatch: nginx-thrift points at localhost:8080 instead of compose-post-service:9090. Separate higher-numbered tasks (scheduling/node labels/taints) confirmed user-service remains Pending due to nodeSelector/taint mismatch. Recommended remediation: update nginx-thrift configuration (ConfigMap/nginx.conf and/or Lua client settings) to call compose-post at the correct service DNS and port (e.g., http://compose-post-service:9090 or the appropriate Thrift endpoint), or deploy the expected local proxy/sidecar if localhost:8080 is intentional; for the pending user-service, remove/adjust the nodeSelector or add the required node label/toleration or fix taints.
